verdict: GBP engagement dropped sharply this week; diagnosis and fixes are underway.
narrative: Across all three of your businesses — Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals — Google Business Profile was the sole source of measurable engagement this period, producing a combined 401 actions (19 calls, 285 direction requests, and 97 web clicks) over the last 28 days. In the most recent 7 days, GBP engagement fell steeply at every location — down 83% at Forte, 86% at Advance Grinding, and 57% at O'Hare — with all three profiles recording zero actions for the last four consecutive days (October 12–15), confirming this is a real visibility drop, not noise. Search data points to a reduction in local search impressions as the likely driver, and the call listings on two O'Hare profiles are being audited after returning zero calls despite receiving impressions all period. Site reindexing is in progress with the goal of recovering impressions by end of October, and outreach sequences are being stood up to open a second lead channel that does not depend on search visibility alone.
